title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1982-08-04
source: Source Info: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B)> Frank Streeter's 1st generation 1/4 track Reels @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell UD35-90B)> Tim Dalton's PCM (Sony SLHF400/Sony HG betamax tape); Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 (wav 16-bit/44.1k)> Adobe Audition 3.0 > TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Good early‑’80s soundboard tape with some audience patches and a quiet bass, but featuring strong blues numbers, a Terrapin Station jam into Drums and a rowdy U.S. Blues encore.
ai_review.review: The show offers several high points – a standout "Looks Like Rain," an adventurous Terrapin Station → Drums sequence, and a rousing U.S. Blues finale – while the overall flow feels like a fun sampler of Summer ’82. The SBD source is generally solid but suffers from a buried Phil Lesh bass and frequent audience‑tape patches that interrupt the listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Review rates the performance positively (4/5) despite noting bass level and patch issues; combined show quality (~4) and recording quality (~3) yields a blended rating around 3.7.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Phil's bass is unusually quiet and the tape includes many audience patches, causing noticeable splits in the audio; overall clarity is decent for an early‑80s SBD.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A varied set with strong blues moments and a high‑energy encore; not consistently saturated with the "X factor" but offers several inspired peaks.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised as an ideal instrumental foil for Brent's piano, contributing to the show's dynamic interplay.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is buried in the mix and difficult to hear, likely a recording issue rather than playing quality.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (on Yamaha electric grand piano) shines, showing adept piano work beyond his usual organ style.
band_member_comments.Drums: Jam into Drums highlighted as fascinating and energetic.
